newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi offers one-month to one-year treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Saudi offers one-month to one-year treasury bills.

text.p: The Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency (SAMA) on Tuesday offered one-month to one-year treasury bills worth two billion Saudi riyals to local banks, bankers said.
The yield on 28-day bills was steady at 5.4217 percent, the rate on 91-day paper climbed to 5.4836 percent from 5.4360, while the yield on 182-day bills was flat at 5.5444 percent.
SAMA also offered one-year treasury bills for the first time, priced at 94.57813, yielding 5.5569 percent.
One-month interbank deposits were at 5-9/16, 7/16 percent, three months 5-5/8, 1/2 percent and six months were 5-11/16, 9/16 percent. One-year interbank rates were 5-13/16, 11/16.

SAMA has advised banks it will issue the bills on Tuesdays rather than Mondays. It has also cut down the amount to two billion riyals from three billion and begun offering one-year bills on a weekly basis, the bankers said.
